svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.23.3.5 Fasteners for Sheathing or Subflooring
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.23 WOOD-FRAME CONSTRUCTION
Fasteners for Sheathing or Subflooring

g.text: Crown parallel to framing, wire not
Roofing nail for fibreboard or gypsum
Subflooring, wall sheathing not in a required braced wall panel, and roof sheathing where the HWP is
not more than 0.6 kPa and Smax for Site Class C is not more than 0.47
Roof sheathing where 0.6 kPa < HWP ≤ 1.2 kPa, or where Smax for Site Class C > 0.47 and Smax ≤ 2.6
Wall sheathing in required braced wall panels: reference framing types
HWP > 1.2 kPa, Smax > 2.6, or Smax for Site Class C > 0.47 for 3-storey buildings of heavy weight
construction or clad at full height with masonry or stone veneer
Fasteners for Subflooring and for Sheathing where the 1-in-50 HWP < 0.8 kPa and Sa(0.2) ≤ 0.70
Minimum Number or Maximum Spacing of Fasteners (1)
Board lumber 184 mm or less wide
Board lumber more than 184 mm wide
Fibreboard sheathing up to 13 mm thick
Gypsum sheathing up to 13 mm thick
Plywood, OSB or waferboard up to 10 mm thick
Plywood, OSB or waferboard over 10 mm and up to 20 mm
Plywood, OSB or waferboard over 20 mm and up to 25 mm
150 mm o.c. along edges and 300 mm o.c. along
Notes to Table 9.23.3.5.-A: (1) See Note A-9.23.3.1.(2).

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
Fastening of (a) subflooring, (b) wall sheathing not in
a required braced wall panel, and (c) roof sheathing
where the 1-in-50-year HWP is not greater than 0.6 kPa
and Smax for Site Class C is not greater than 0.47,
conforms to Table 9.23.3.5.-A.
Except as in Sentence (4), roof sheathing is fastened to
Table 9.23.3.5.-B where the HWP is over 0.6 kPa but not
over 1.2 kPa, or Smax for Site Class C is over 0.47 but
Smax is not over 2.6.
Except as in Sentence (4), wall sheathing in required
braced wall panels is fastened to the reference framing
types in Table 9.23.3.5.-C.
These conform to Part 4 where the HWP is over 1.2 kPa,
Smax is over 2.6, or Smax for Site Class C is over 0.47
for 3-storey buildings of heavy weight construction or
clad at full height with masonry or stone veneer.
Staples are not less than 1.6 mm in diameter or
thickness, with a crown not less than 9.5 mm, driven
with the crown parallel to framing.
Roofing nails for fibreboard or gypsum sheathing are not
less than 3.2 mm in diameter, with a head not less than
Flooring screws are not less than 3.2 mm in diameter.
Table title as printed: its limits differ from Sentence (1). Tables -B and -C are in the Code. Fastener details drawn close up.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.23.3.5. (page 9-169)
